description: This file defines classes related to monitoring dimensions within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically for receiver, cache, and block pool monitors.

classes.name: ReceiverMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Represents the dimensions for receiver monitor, primarily identified by a queue ID.

classes.name: CacheMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Extends ReceiverMonitorDimensions to include a block pool ID for cache monitoring.

classes.name: BlockPoolMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Represents dimensions for block pool monitoring, identified by a block pool ID.

methods.name: ReceiverMonitorDimensions(string queueId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver monitor dimensions with a specific queue ID.

methods.name: CacheMonitorDimensions(string queueId, string blockPoolId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache monitor dimensions with queue ID and block pool ID.

methods.name: BlockPoolMonitorDimensions(string blockPoolId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing block pool monitor dimensions with a block pool ID.
